title: GetURDFrobotData: visual primitives, the names of the base links, the order of the links
author: Claude-JG
description: GetURDFrobotData reads only meshes as visual geometry, so boxes, cylinders and spheres in the visual elements of a URDF are left out; the names of the links fixed to the base are not stored; whether a parent always precedes its children in the link list is not checked. Decided: read the primitives as graphics, store the base link names, reorder or refuse an order with a child before its parent.
releaseNotes: GetURDFrobotData draws the boxes, cylinders and spheres of the visual elements of a URDF, returns the names of the links fixed to the base in baseLinkNames, and takes the links with each parent before its children, so that a fixed link listed before its joint link keeps its mass and graphics.
